subject: Re: Quick follow-up — SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, and trust portal access
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acmehealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, and trust portal access

Hi John — great to meet today, thanks for taking the time. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Ask: Acme would like Redwood's latest SOC 2 Type II report, a bridge letter if the report doesn't cover 2026, and access to our trust portal for your security team.
- Scope notes: We support HIPAA-covered workloads (BAA available) and can discuss data residency options; noted your question about EU data residency — we have region controls and can scope the deployment.
- Procurement timeline: you mentioned aiming to complete vendor security review by the end of July. We'll prioritize getting the materials to you today.

Planned next steps:
1) I will share the SOC 2 Type II PDF and a bridge letter (if applicable) and send a trust portal invite for your security reviewers.
2) Aditya (cc'd) will confirm any technical evidence items if your team requests deeper artifacts.
3) Please share the contact for anyone on your side who should get trust portal access (names/emails).

If that aligns, I'll push the docs and access now.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: planned: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf]

Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, and trust portal access

Thanks Marissa — that sounds good.

Can you please: 
- Send the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (PDF).
- Send a bridge letter that covers activity since the report date (if applicable).
- Create trust portal access for our security reviewer(s): john.doe@acmehealth.com and procurement@acmehealth.com.

- Does Redwood have a signed BAA to support HIPAA workloads?
- Any notes on data residency options for US/EU?
- We may need a DocuSign for a standard security addendum during procurement.

Procurement is targeting EOW 7/31, so the sooner the materials the better.

Appreciate it,
John
Director, IT Security
Acme Health

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (SOC 2 Type II report) | Redwood_Bridge_Letter_2026.pdf (bridge letter covering activities through 06/30/2026)

Trust portal access:
- Access link: https://redwood.trustportal.com/acme-health/access-request?token=AB12CD34
- Invited: john.doe@acmehealth.com, procurement@acmehealth.com (you should receive an invite email within the hour).
- If your reviewer needs read-only access vs. evidence download, let me know and Aditya can scope permissions.

- BAA: Yes — we offer a Business Associate Agreement for HIPAA customers. If you want a copy, I can route a standard BAA to you or we can include it in DocuSign with procurement.
- Data residency: We run in US and EU regions; for Acme we can pin to US-only regions or discuss hybrid options for sensitive datasets.
- DocuSign: happy to push a security addendum / BAA through DocuSign — please share the procurement contact and I'll initiate.

Looping in security details for tracking — I reviewed the bridge letter and SOC 2 PDF Marissa attached. A couple notes for procurement if they request evidence: 
- Evidence access: we can provide hashed artifact bundles and scoped evidence via the trust portal for reviewers who sign an NDA.
- Permissions: portal can be restricted to view-only or evidence-download; recommend view-only initially.
- Timeline: if Acme requests deeper artifact review, give us 3-5 business days to prepare redacted evidence.

Marissa — I can be the point for any technical evidence requests. Tag me on the portal invite if they need permission changes.

Thanks,
Aditya
